item.title: Digital badge no longer mandatory for advanced practice nurses under ARRS
item.description: An NHS accreditation scheme that has been criticised as a barrier to employment for advanced practice nurses in general practice will no longer be a mandatory requirement for recruitment under the additional roles reimbursement scheme (ARRS).
